purpose: Teach: 本島/丹波/三条/名護/代々木/松戸/加賀/小田原

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、沖縄本島、つまり本島旅行に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our customer took a trip to Okinawa's main island.
lines.style: Soft, half-wondering tone. Gentle accumulation of small details. Speaking as if piecing together a quiet picture. Warm curiosity without pressure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、京都丹波地方の黒豆がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She loves black beans from the Tamba region in Kyoto.
lines.style: Continuing the gentle inventory with the same thoughtful pace. Voice settles on each detail like it matters. Intimate observation, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新潟県三条市の金物製品を愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Our customer uses metal tools from Sanjo in Niigata.
lines.style: Building the portrait steadily. Each fact spoken with quiet care, as if Mei is learning Aoi's customer through these small pieces. Lean in slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、沖縄県名護市にお住まいの友人がいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She has a friend who lives in Nago, Okinawa.
lines.style: The same warm inventory continues. No rush. Each sentence opens a small window. Voice is gentle, genuinely interested in what these details reveal.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東京の代々木公園を散歩されるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She takes walks in Yoyogi Park in Tokyo.
lines.style: Still the same patient, accumulating tone. Each detail adds another layer to who this customer is. Soft and genuine, building connection through attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、千葉県松戸市のご出身だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's from Matsudo in Chiba Prefecture.
lines.style: Voice continues with the same tender, gathering-details rhythm. Speaking like these small facts are precious. Unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、石川県加賀温泉に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Our customer goes to Kaga hot springs in Ishikawa.
lines.style: The inventory deepens. Voice carries the weight of noticing—of caring about the small things someone has shared. Still gentle, still close.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、神奈川県小田原のかまぼこがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She loves kamaboko from Odawara in Kanagawa.
lines.style: Final detail, settling with quiet warmth. Voice closes gently, as if the picture is now complete. Tender conclusion, lingering slightly on the last detail.
